warnings: sample imbalance 23 vs 6: the per-sample Mann-Whitney test is dominated by the larger group; report effect sizes alongside p-values

5 donor-condition pair(s) hold more than one library (P2 (Omentum): 3, P3 (Omentum): 3, P4 (Omentum): 3, P5 (Omentum): 2, P6 (Omentum): 3): libraries from one donor in one condition are not independent replicates; the sample column over-counts replication. Either use the donor as sample_key (pool its libraries) or state the inflation in the report

covariate 'region' is nested within the condition (every level occurs in one condition only; 5 levels for 2 conditions). If its levels are biological sub-groups of the condition (regions, sub-sites, grades) nothing is lost; if they are processing batches, condition and region cannot be separated. Say which in the write-up
